scope.flow: emergency pause freeze of TrustBonding escrow state

statements.text: The TrustBonding contract is in the paused state (pause flag is set).
TrustBonding inherits the VotingEscrow entry points create_lock, increase_amount, increase_unlock_time, and withdraw.
A caller invokes an inherited VotingEscrow entry point while the contract is paused.
Only claimRewards() is guarded by whenNotPaused; the inherited VotingEscrow entry points never consult paused().
Core escrow state transitions (lock creation, modification, withdrawals) remain live while the contract is paused.
The protocol cannot freeze these escrow operations despite the pause flag, weakening emergency response and contradicting operators' belief that the contract is paused.

Pausing TrustBonding should halt all escrow state-changing operations (lock creation, modification, withdrawals), not only claimRewards(). Inferred: the reported failure is only a defect if the pause is intended to freeze all such state changes.
Some caller actually invokes these entry points during the paused window; the report asserts capability, not a verified incident.
